title: UNICEF contribution to the well-being of children in Latin America and the Caribbean
authors: UNICEF Latin America and Caribbean Regional Office
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The 2015 report describes Guatemala’s midwife breastfeeding initiative in 25 municipalities and four departments. Health-service personnel had completed training and were prepared to exchange knowledge with midwives; certification was projected, not established.
